rewrites.//: SPA fallback. Redundant while the app uses createHashRouter (every route lives after the #), but it is what makes a future switch to createBrowserRouter a one-line change instead of a hosting migration.

headers.//: Default: revalidate everything. A stale service worker is exactly how the old GitHub Pages deploy pinned installed apps to a dead build, so the entry point, sw.js and the manifest must never be cached. Later matches override this for the fingerprinted files below.
Vite fingerprints everything under assets/ with a content hash, so a given URL's bytes never change.
Icons are not fingerprinted, but they change roughly never.

emulators.//: Not the default 5000 — macOS AirPlay Receiver squats on that port and answers 403.
